# Maven Enterprise Ltd

> Maven Enterprise Ltd supplies and installs premium interior finishing products across Nairobi and Kenya — interior décor, sanitary ware, kitchen fittings, flooring, lighting, doors & hardware, and plumbing supplies — serving homeowners, architects, contractors and developers with both product supply and professional installation.

Maven Enterprise Ltd is a Kenyan interior-finishing supplier and installer. Current contact details, service areas, business hours and social links are maintained on the site and should be read from the pages below rather than assumed, since they may change over time.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.mavenenterprise.co.ke/): Overview of products, services, featured work and client testimonials.
- [Products](https://www.mavenenterprise.co.ke/products): Full product catalogue by category — interior décor, flooring, bathroom, kitchen, lighting, doors & hardware, plumbing, and general supplies.
- [Services](https://www.mavenenterprise.co.ke/services): Installation services offered, from single-room work to full building fit-outs.
- [Projects](https://www.mavenenterprise.co.ke/projects): Completed residential, commercial, office, hospitality and retail case studies across Kenya.
- [About Us](https://www.mavenenterprise.co.ke/about): Company background, mission, values and team.
- [Blog](https://www.mavenenterprise.co.ke/blog): Interior design tips, buying guides and Kenyan home trends.
- [Contact](https://www.mavenenterprise.co.ke/contact): Current phone, WhatsApp, email, address and business hours, plus inquiry forms (general, bulk purchase, contractor registration, supplier registration).
- [Request a Quote](https://www.mavenenterprise.co.ke/quote): Free quotation request form for products, installation, or both.

## Notes

- Prices, stock status and service areas are managed live and can change; always prefer the current page content over cached or summarized figures.
- For sourcing, quoting, or partnership inquiries, direct readers to the Contact or Quote pages rather than guessing at contact details.
